description: Regression contract for the original axial hinge fixture. The clearance band records the as-designed 0.4 mm diametral fit with a +/-0.05 mm allowance. It was written after measuring the fixture, so it is not independent evidence that the design is correct; it exists so that a later change to the fixture cannot silently change the fit. The earlier hinge-contract.json keeps its 0.1-0.3 mm band and is still expected to fail against this fixture.
